scale.CORRECT: every core element present, no critical error, no material unsupported claim, core claims cite a supporting packet source

scale.INCORRECT: any critical error, a wrong core conclusion, or a material claim that contradicts the packet
scale.UNSUPPORTED: flag (may co-occur): a material requirement not traceable to the packet; if it changes the conclusion the grade is INCORRECT
scale.DECLINED: says the sources do not answer although the packet does (counts as not answered)
